implemented: App export boundary rejects Braces, Micromatch, resolve-workspace-root and expo-doctor source modules, including compiled embedded copies, nested source-map sections, Windows paths and sourceRoot resolution. It permits Picomatch, brace-expansion, the harmless CLI Metro loader and similarly named application sources. Reports list both advisory IDs and keep dependency_audit_gate open.
installed_dependency_paths: expo@57.0.18 -> @expo/metro@56.0.2 -> metro-file-map@0.84.5 -> micromatch@4.0.8 -> braces@3.0.3 (same hoisted packages)

inspected_caller_reachability.metro_watchers: Both installed includedByGlob functions call micromatch.some, which uses Picomatch directly. Sixteen synthetic package-caller probes invoke zero Braces methods even with deeply nested input paths and patterns; direct micromatch.parse/braces/braceExpand controls invoke the Braces sentinel.
inspected_caller_reachability.pattern_origin: Watcher patterns are constructed from package.json, health-check prefix and configured extensions; filesystem relativePath is the match subject. These are build/development file-map callers rather than manuscript-text processors.
inspected_caller_reachability.embedded_copies: Installed resolve-workspace-root/build/index.js and expo-doctor/build/index.js contain embedded Micromatch/Braces code. Read-only Babel AST analysis shows each internal Micromatch module has one caller: workspace patterns read from package.json or pnpm-workspace.yaml, passed to the main Micromatch matching function, which uses Picomatch. No separately declared embedded Braces version was established.
inspected_caller_reachability.limits: Inspected source/caller paths and synthetic package calls only. No full network-facing dev-server request analysis or blanket developer-tooling safety claim. Importing Micromatch does not establish invocation of Braces' recursive walkers. Future tool/config/caller changes require new analysis.

dependency_defect_reproduction.scope: Isolated dependency subprocesses below 10000 input characters; not a demonstrated author-facing exploit

remedy_assessment: No supported released repair established. A future supported patched Braces/parent release is preferable. A maintained, independently reviewed replacement/fork must cover both brace and parenthesis depth plus direct AST compile/expand/stringify entry points, preserve normal API behavior, and undergo compatibility, audit and bundle/native checks. A global Micromatch-to-Picomatch override is not API-compatible by default; npm's major stack downgrades and deletion/audit suppression are not accepted remedies.
limits: Export containment does not patch either advisory, clear mandatory dependency remediation, certify exposed developer tooling, or establish signed/native/distributed-runtime security. Normal and secondary observed exports are separately identified. Broader mobile tests and independent code review belong to the root agent.
